title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Definition: Closing Date of the Calibration Window
content:
**Definition.** For network courtesy days on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the window's closing date of the lost calibration days depends on the rental: where a return is recorded on the reservation and the calibration order has no completion date or was completed after that return, it is the return date; where no return is recorded and the calibration order has no completion date, it is today's date; otherwise it is the calibration order's completion date.

## Records read

The return date on the reservation, and the completion date of the calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for.

## Closing date table

| Return recorded on the reservation | Calibration order completion | Closing date |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None | The return date |
| Yes | After the return date | The return date |
| Yes | On or before the return date | The completion date |
| No | None | Today's date |
| No | Completed | The completion date |

## Date cases (hypothetical)

- Returned on the 10th, calibration completed on the 12th: the closing date is the 10th.
- Returned on the 10th, calibration completed on the 10th: completed on, not after, the return, so the closing date is the completion date, the 10th.
- Returned on the 10th, calibration completed on the 8th: the closing date is the 8th.
- Still on rent and the calibration not yet complete, today being the 15th: the closing date is the 15th.
